title: Pulse-Width Modulation
official: Pulse-width Modulation During Pedicle Screw Stimulation
summary: The overarching aim of this project is to modulate the pulse-width during stimulation of pedicle screws and record the response thresholds associated with each PWM setting. During this initial phase of the investigation, no further data will be collected.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* A patient will be eligible for study participation once they have been booked for a surgery involving pedicle screw placement and intraoperative neuromonitoring.

Exclusion Criteria:

* The study excludes neonates, minors, pregnant women, prisoners and cognitively impaired patients.
